author: Huawei
description: At MWC 2026 Barcelona, Yang Chaobin, CEO of #Huawei's ICT Business Group, noted that new AI applications are emerging every day, and the industry should collaborate to unleash the full potential of 5G-A. He said: "We must efficiently utilize new spectrum resources like U6 GHz to create new value for the industry while paving the way for evolution to 6G." https://bit.ly/4rSbpm6 #MWC26 #AdvancingAllIntelligence
title: Yang Chaobin: Fast-Tracking AI with 5G-A and U6 GHz on the Path to 6G​
